claim_boundary.note: Fixture smoke evidence only. This generates a coverage report for the checked-in fixture, not for production crates; it does not enforce production coverage budgets, post statuses, mutate branch protection, prove live cloud-ci/oya-ci required-context execution, prove P0.0 green, prove Phase-0 completion, prove production readiness, or prove hyperscaler-grade readiness.

implementation_summary: Added scripts/ci/run-rust-llvm-coverage-smoke.py to compile a checked-in Rust fixture with rustc -C instrument-coverage, run both fixture branches under LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=%m-%p.profraw, merge profiles with rustup-sysroot llvm-profdata merge -sparse, and export/report with llvm-cov.
Added //:rust-llvm-coverage-smoke-check as Buck2-owned local fixture evidence and regression shell tests for PASS, missing source, and missing llvm-profdata failure cases.

Updated the coverage runner contract, policy chain, and testing standard to require sysroot-derived LLVM tools for local smoke, trusted cloud-ci/Buck2 toolchain pinning for authority, and non-authority boundaries for fixture reports.
known_gaps: This target generates coverage for a small fixture only; it does not generate coverage for production Rust crates.
No production coverage budget is enforced by this slice.
No live cloud-ci/oya-ci required context has run this target on candidate SHA.
Local Cargo mutation testing remains advisory unless captured by a Buck2 target or trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci lane.
